official_identity_sources.observation: The official product surface identifies Sistema 7 Wall Unit by Vincent Van Duysen and describes the horizontally folding mechanism. The current public route does not expose an exact native CAD file without a My Area workflow.

Official catalogue pages visually identify the wall unit, show the folding-door form and publish widths 980/1960 mm, heights 722/1083 mm and depth 331 mm. These pages are identity and nominal-dimension evidence, not native Plan/Front/Side CAD geometry.

The near-name Sistema 7 download surface is for the full-height door product and is explicitly excluded as geometry evidence for this Sistema 7 Wall Unit. Its authenticated DWG listing must not be substituted for the wall-unit product.

official_product_cad.reason: No exact native Wall Unit CAD file was acquired from the verified public manufacturer surfaces. The authenticated DWG advertised for the separate full-height Sistema 7 Doors product is not this wall unit and is excluded.

dimension_cross_check.semantic_axis_mapping: local X=official width; local Y=project Body depth envelope; local Z=official height
dimension_cross_check.note: Width and height mechanically match the official 1960 x 722 mm standard size class. The 369 mm project Body depth envelope is 38 mm above the 331 mm catalogue depth and remains project-model geometry only; no fabrication inference or scaling is permitted.
